title: Alice the Camel
transcription:
Alice the Camel

Alice the Camel has, five humps,
Alice the Camel has, five humps,
Alice the Camel has, five humps,
So go Alice go. (boom, boom, boom...)

...Four humps,
...Three humps,
...Two humps
...One hump,
...No humps, so Alice is a horse!
